item.text:
The Next.js reading tracker is ready. The home page shows books you’re reading and books you’ve finished. You can add a book, mark it finished, open its detail page to see and edit notes, and copy a direct link to that book.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and remain there after a server restart. Run `npm install` and `npm run dev`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md).

The build and tests pass. I also checked adding, finishing, and editing a book through the running app, then confirmed its direct link still worked after a restart. Shared links require access to the same server; with no accounts, anyone who can access the app can change its books.
